items.quote: mobilized his entire army and marched up and laid siege to Samaria.
items.contrast: Mobilizing the army first versus laying siege after marching to Samaria.
items.reason: The ordered verb sequence places mobilization before the march and siege, so the key uniquely identifies the first action.

items.contrast: The information about the deserted camp versus the Aramean camp itself.
items.reason: “The news” merely repeats the passage’s generic label and does not state what information was reported. Asking what message reached the palace and keying the report that the camp was deserted would repair the item. Tracking the indirectly relayed message is a meaningful reference distinction.

items.contrast: A curse occurring after the punishment versus the curse being part of the passage’s summary of how punishment was fulfilled.
items.reason: The final sentence states that the curse came on them, but it does not clearly make this a separate event after God punished them. Sentence order alone does not establish that temporal relation. A bounded rewrite asking what came on the people of Shechem would support the key, though the answer would then be directly stated.

items.quote: put to the sword anyone who follows her.
items.contrast: The woman is ordered to be brought out, whereas anyone following her is explicitly ordered to be put to the sword.
items.reason: The command assigns different actions to the woman and her followers. Although the woman is later put to death, the explicit sword command applies uniquely to her followers.

items.quote: the people of Shechem went out to the fields, and this was reported to Abimelek. So he took his men, divided them into three companies and set an ambush in the fields.
items.contrast: The reported movement into the fields prompts the ambush, while Abimelek’s later sighting of people leaving the city prompts the attack.
items.reason: The causal connector “So” links the report about the people going into the fields to Abimelek’s decision to set the ambush. The later observation is a separate trigger for attacking.
